purpose: Continue contA from epoch 25 to epoch 50 with the cosine decay horizon bound to the real budget, so the learning rate actually anneals to min_lr instead of staying near its 3e-4 peak

parent_checkpoint.name: last.ckpt of the contA run (epoch 25, step 62600, state=completed)

diagnosis.observed: contA held val/loss between 15.51 and 16.77 for 15 epochs with the best checkpoint still at epoch 10 (15.5080); the final epoch degraded 8.2%
diagnosis.root_cause: the official WarmupCosLR is hard-coded to epochs=100 while the run stopped at 25, so the cosine term only advanced 33 of 180 degrees and lr fell from 3.0e-4 to 2.59e-4 (-13%)
diagnosis.evidence: checkpoint lr_schedulers state: last_epoch=21 at epoch 20 with _last_lr=[2.7531e-4, 1.3765e-4]
diagnosis.this_run: scheduler_epochs=50 caps the horizon at the planned end; the cosine term reaches 180 degrees at epoch 50 and lr reaches min_lr=1e-6

learning_rate_expectation.note: the epoch 25 -> 26 step drops 40% because the horizon shrinks from 100 to 50; this is the deferred annealing being applied once, not a new hyper-parameter

validation.objective: paper-v1: forward_train branch, frozen dropout, seed=epoch*100003+batch_idx
validation.extra_cost: one additional 2-step diffusion forward per validation batch

test.usage: not loaded during training, checkpoint selection or tuning

monitor_rationale.legacy: val/loss used 12 * plain L1 for the trajectory term (forward_test has no loss keys); the paper/monitor ratio moved between 2.47 and 4.38 across five re-evaluated checkpoints, so it does not rank checkpoints consistently
monitor_rationale.note: ADE/FDE stay computed from forward_test and remain diagnostics only

acceptance.role: single-variable test of whether the plateau was caused by the missing cosine decay
succeeds_if: val/paper_loss breaks below the ep10 reference of 69.28 (2048-frame subset) and keeps falling
val/loss breaks below the current best 15.5080
val/trajectory_loss breaks below the arm-A best 6.29
means_plateau_is_structural_if: val/paper_loss oscillates without a new minimum through epoch 40
learning rate is already below 5e-5 and the trajectory term has not improved
stop_or_investigate_if: val/paper_loss rises for two consecutive epochs
val/paper_agent_box_loss or val/paper_agent_class_loss exceeds 1.5x its best-so-far value

guardrails: official V1 model, loss, trajectory targets and scheduler source unchanged; only the horizon value is injected
single variable changed versus contA: the cosine horizon (100 -> 50); peak lr, batch, accumulation, clip and data stay identical
validation objective matches the training objective; training math and gradients untouched
dropout frozen and sampling seed fixed so the monitor is comparable across epochs
full validation every epoch; val/paper_loss is the only checkpoint monitor
BEV degradation is a separate known issue (trajectory branch contributes 99.5% of the gradient norm) and is not addressed here
Test split is frozen and never loaded during training or tuning
